remarks: Requesting all offers, highest and best by 7/29, 12:00pm. Welcome to 27 County Street! Lovingly maintained by its original owner. This picturesque Ranch exudes both warmth and character. Once inside you will find hardwood floors, wood-burning fireplace and sun drenched living spaces that create a bright and inviting atmosphere. Two generously sized bedrooms, one full bath and a spacious lower level that offers plenty of storage space complete the interior. Outside you will be excited about the level and expansive backyard. This charming home is ideally located near schools, shopping and all that bustling Norwalk has to offer. This is a fantastic home for first time homebuyers, down sizers and investors.   A great home and opportunity await!
